name: Manila Panoramax first three photo-specific building and street observations
description: Only the three named existing Panoramax images. Contains capture points, camera-resolved photographed building/street targets where possible, and explicitly unverified nearby building candidates otherwise. Descriptions are manual visual observations, not inferred unseen facade details.
source: Existing repository Panoramax JPEGs + Panoramax STAC item metadata + committed Manila building/transportation GeoJSON

properties.visual_description: Narrow pedestrian street paved with reddish interlocking brick. On the left is a low pale-pink perimeter wall with a tall dark metal gate, a red medical-cross sign and a small posted sign; palm foliage and dense overhead utility cables cross the view. A white multi-storey building rises behind the trees. On the right is a long weathered light-grey masonry facade with repeated openings and a narrow raised concrete sidewalk.
properties.facade_description_observed: pale-pink plaster perimeter wall, dark metal gate and red medical-cross sign; adjoining weathered light-grey masonry facade
properties.openings_observed: large metal gate; repeated rectangular openings on the right-side facade, details partly obscured
properties.street_furniture_observed: palm trees, overhead utility cables, narrow concrete sidewalks
properties.signage_observed: red medical-cross sign and a small wall-mounted poster
properties.visual_cautions: Do not infer unseen windows, doors, balconies, exact material composition or building use beyond visible evidence.

properties.visual_description: Straight urban street with grey asphalt/concrete carriageway and a curb painted alternating yellow and white. The left side has a pale masonry wall and an ornate light-coloured facade with a tall arched entrance, decorative mouldings and turquoise/green trim around the ground-floor openings. The right side is a long yellow-and-cream multi-storey facade with repeated arched ground-floor bays, columns and dark awnings/signboards.

properties.openings_observed: large arched entrance and smaller ground-floor openings on the left; repeated arched openings on the right

properties.visual_description: Street bordered on the left by a long dark, rough stone masonry wall and an older pale stone building rising behind it, with a high curved/parapet-like roofline. On the right foreground is a tall modern light-grey building with large plain wall panels. A red car is parked near the right side.
